placement: qpos[object.qpos_adr:+7] = (x, y, spawn_drop_m, cos(yaw/2), 0, 0, sin(yaw/2)); qvel[object.dof_adr:+6] = 0; mj_forward (lift_scene.place_object)
success: object height qpos[object.qpos_adr + 2] >= lift_success_m continuously for hold_success_s of sim time
upright: z of cross(rotation_column_0, rotation_column_1); below min_upright on the table = knocked over
start_pose_source: per-joint median of frame-0 observation.state over data/so101_state_all8
start_pose_check: objects on a 1 cm grid over the play area x yaw [0, 45, 90, 135] deg; listed placements touch the arm or do not settle (evaluate.set_up_trial)
start_pose_keepout_rule: objects[].start_pose_keepout: start_pose_blocked_box grown by 0.01 m on every side and clipped to the play area (placements just outside the grid box can still touch the arm); null if none blocked

object_state.name: rotation_column_0
object_state.how: q = (w, x, y, z) = qpos[object.qpos_adr + 3 : + 7], MuJoCo's mju_quat2Mat (no normalisation): [w*w + x*x - y*y - z*z, 2*(x*y + w*z), 2*(x*z - w*y)]

object_state.name: rotation_column_1
object_state.how: q = (w, x, y, z) = qpos[object.qpos_adr + 3 : + 7], MuJoCo's mju_quat2Mat (no normalisation): [2*(x*y - w*z), w*w - x*x + y*y - z*z, 2*(y*z + w*x)]

object_state.name: size_m
object_state.how: constant per object: objects[].size_m (bounding box of the collision mesh in the object's body frame, lift_scene.object_size_m); copy it, do not recompute
